title: Shah Mosque, Tehran

buildingCutout.basis: The mapped perimeter replaces the procedural mosque mass without removing adjoining bazaar buildings.

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified original elevation near the center of the mapped courtyard.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap relation 17091736 and mapped open courtyard, basin and Grand Bazaar approach
mapIdentity.scope: The named Tehran mosque relation 17091736 contains a 14-point exterior and four-point courtyard. The basin is separately mapped. The northern bazaar stair trace is retained as orientation evidence.

note: Flandin’s published nineteenth-century plate shows the court, inset rectangular basin, monumental portal proportions, recessed painted vault and lower flanking arcades. Research by Fadakari and Andaroodi and the Smithsonian collection establish the southern dome and the later northern clock and twin minarets.
